title: gh api repos/{owner}/{repo}/environments/${environment}/deployment-branch-policies?per_page=100
description: The branch and tag policies of one environment that has custom ones, ${environment} its name URL-encoded, which kit reads in `modules/bash/forge/github.sh` (forge/github:environments), 20 environments at most, and folds in `modules/jq/forge.jq` (forge::github_branch_policies); a total_count past the page fails the read. The types are the deployment branch policy of GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/environments/{environment_name}/deployment-branch-policies in GitHub's REST description, https://github.com/github/rest-api-description, as https://docs.github.com/rest/deployments/branch-policies describes it: type is branch or tag. Checked live on vercel/next.js.
